questions.q: In the context of digital video encoding, what is the primary advantage of using a variable bitrate over a constant bitrate?
options: Allocating more data bits to complex, fast-motion scenes and fewer bits to static scenes to optimize quality and file size
Ensuring the final file size can be mathematically calculated precisely before encoding begins
Eliminating the need for any audio codec during playback
Forcing all video frames to render at an identical resolution
